then.text: Thank you again. The pie will be ready by sundown.
Still looking? {apples} of three so far. Try round the houses and by the trees.

greet.text: Ah, a new face. Welcome to the village.
My cart tipped over this morning and three apples rolled away.

asked.text: Bless you. Bring all three back to me here by the well.

thanks.text: All three! You have sharp eyes.
The elder beams. Somewhere a villager cheers.
